inputs_used: Orchestrator task message (4-slot brief, fast mode)

slots.purpose: Hero: show the article's subject at a glance (a gentle, elegant RSVP reminder) in a refined, luxury tone.
slots.shot_brief: Still life, no people. A printed RSVP reminder card or folded note card on a styled desk: heavy cotton paper, letterpress or foil detail, neutral palette (ivory, sage, soft gold), fountain pen, wax seal or ribbon, a few stems of seasonal flowers, soft window light from one side. Card text uses placeholder names only (e.g. 'Alex & Sam') and 'Kindly reply by [date]' with no real date, no real couple, no third-party stationery branding. Wide 3:2 crop with headroom for a title overlay. Preferred source: own shoot or licensed stock added to the Drive library and register. AI is allowed only if Nic approves in writing, then captioned 'Illustrative image'.
slots.alt: Printed wedding RSVP reminder card with a fountain pen and flowers on a styled desk
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] Caption depends on source: 'Photo: <credit>' for a licensed photo, or 'Illustrative image' if Nic approves an AI still life in writing.

slots.purpose: Illustrate the reminder message wording section: a short, warm digital reminder as a guest would see it.
slots.shot_brief: Close crop of a hand holding a phone (no face, no rings or tattoos that identify anyone) showing a short reminder message with placeholder names only. Screen content must be a Wonderland Studio screenshot with sample names supplied by the team, composited onto a licensed or own-shot phone image; no third-party app screens, logos, notification badges or real contact details. Warm, natural light, linen or marble surface behind. 3:2 or 4:5 inline crop. If the team supplies the Studio screenshot alone, it can run as a plain screenshot (caption 'Wonderland Studio, sample names').
slots.alt: Phone screen showing a short wedding RSVP reminder message with sample names
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] Draft: 'A reminder message in Wonderland Studio, shown with sample names.' Add photo credit if a licensed phone photo is used.

slots.purpose: Show the couple's side of the process: reviewing who has and hasn't replied before sending reminders.
slots.shot_brief: Couple in their 30s at home reviewing their guest list together: laptop or printed list on a dining table or sofa, coffee cups, relaxed and warm, late-afternoon light, stylish but lived-in interior. Screens show no third-party apps, logos or real guest names (blank, blurred or Wonderland Studio with sample names). Identifiable people need a signed model release or documented couple consent, recorded in the register. Prefer licensed stock (Stocksy/Offset) or a Wedded Wonderland shoot. Never AI (real people and a real wedding context).
slots.alt: Couple at home reviewing their wedding guest list together on a laptop
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] Caption: 'Photo: <credit>' once licensed; record model release or consent.

slots.purpose: Tie reminders to destination and multi-event weddings: why a firm reply date matters when guests travel and attend welcome drinks, the ceremony and a farewell event.
slots.shot_brief: Real destination wedding setting suggesting guests arriving: a welcome drinks terrace, aperitivo table or welcome sign at a Wedded Wonderland partner venue, golden hour, guests seen from behind or at a distance (not identifiable) or no people at all. Real place, so never AI. Source order: Drive image library (register row with licence and consent), then a weddedwonderland.com partner venue page if the supply agreement covers blog use, then a venue press kit via a Gmail draft permission request. Venue and town must be verified by register, EXIF or source page and named in the caption.
slots.alt: Welcome drinks set up on a terrace as destination wedding guests arrive at golden hour
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] Format: '<Place>, <town>. Photo: <credit>'.
